tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (351)༄༅/ /bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang rtsa ba'i phyag len bslad med sgrub thabs rin 'byung las khol du phyungs pa bzhugs so/ /
(351)༄༅/ /bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang rtsa ba'i phyag len bslad med sgrub thabs rin 'byung las khol du phyungs pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (351)༄༅// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang rtsa ba'i phyag len bslad med sgrub thabs rin 'byung las khol du phyungs pa bzhugs so//

(352)༄༅// oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun las ches lhag pa'i// lhag bsam smon lam dge ba can// shākya seng ge la btud nas// de'i sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rnams sngon du btang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ ser po'i 'od kyis lus gang*/ rang nyid thub pa'i dbang po'i skur gyur pa ni// sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu phyag g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can// mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing*/ thugs mnyam par bzhag pa'i bdag nyid du gyur// thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐/ (353)de las 'od 'phros thub pa ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ yid kyis phyag mchod bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spyi bor oṃ dkar po// mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba bsgom la/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ thun 'jog khar ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs pa la/ ārghaṃ nas shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ dges bsngo/ oṃ muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod las bya/ 'di'i lung 'bogs rtsal ni/ thub pa'i sku gzugs bris 'bur gang rung zhig gi mdun du maṇḍal la me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ oṃ las byung ba'i mchod par mos/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badzra sa ra pra mardha nā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ārha te samya (354)ksaṃ mburdhaya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā badzre/ ma hā bidyā badzre/ ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi mand+ro pa saṃ kra ma ṇe sarba karma ā ba ra ṇe bi sho dha ni swā hā/

ces mchod sprin gyis gzungs bzla/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal bar sngar bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du padma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūm̐ ser po las thub pa'i dbang po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu sogs nas bzlas pa'i bar btang*/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bsham pa 'di// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wa ra bhyaḥbadzra ārghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ /des 'dres te/ shabda 'i bar btang*/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes sogs kyis bstod/ slob ma la chab btang*/ maṇḍal bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de'ang sangs rgyas thams cad ni spangs rtogs kyi yon tan dang dgongs pa mnyam zhing ris su ma chad pa'i thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can yin mod/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir rtsod ldan snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i gdul dka'i 'gro ba rnams 'dul ba la rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i thugs bskyed kyi stobs dang mdzad pa'i phrin las rmad du byung ba bdag cag gi ston pa shākya seng ge'i sgrub thabs rnam grangs mang du mchis pa las/ 'dir sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam 'phrul jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas thugs sras 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la lhag pa'i lha 'ga' zhig gdams kha bskur bas ched du gdams par mdzad pa'i bka' gdams lha bzhi zhes grags pa'i thog ma bstan pa 'di'i bdag po ston pa shākya thub pa'i sgom bzlas dang lha khrid nyams su len pa'i snod rung du byed pa sgom bzlas kyi lugs jo bo yab sras kyi phyag bzhes gtsang ma bsgrub par bgyi ba la zhu ba'i (355)yon tu dmigs te maṇḍal 'bul mdzod/ /ces brda sbyar la maṇḍal 'bul gzhug /bsags sbyong spel ba so so'i ting nge 'dzin gsal thob la yan lag bdun pa gsung ba zhu/

ji snyed su dag sogs/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal thob la 'di gsung ba zhu/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs lan gsum/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du sogs gang gi mngon rtogs ltar la/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par sgoms shig /de nas khyed rang rnams kyis slob dpon la mos gus dung dung mdzad pas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung ste snying gar thim pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ snying po lan gsum/ me tog 'thor la/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus mthu thams cad thog med du 'jug par gyur cig /oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/ des bka' gdams lha bzhi las thub pa'i dbang po'i sgom bzlas kyi lung phog grub pa lags pas gtong rag tu maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ /zhes maṇḍal 'bul gzhug /dge rtsa byang chub chen por bsngo bas rgyas 'debs par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ rjes mdun bskyed la mchod pa kha bsos nas byin brlab/ sngags tsam gyis mchod cing bstod/ na ོ ngas bshags gshegs gsol bsngo smon bkra shis brjod pa rnams spyi ltar bya'o// lha bzhi'i mi g.yo ba la bzlas lung 'bogs pa dang*/ rja ེ sa gnang gnyis ka yod cing*/ gzhan gsum la thun mong ba yin pa'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul tsam las med kyang*/ phyis sgrub thabs brgya rtsa rgyas tshe sogs dang mthun pa'i rjes gnang byed pa ni snying pos dben par shes so// thub pa sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi// sgrub thabs nyams (356) len rab dga' ba// snying nas bka' gdams la mos na// nan tan chen pos 'di sgrubs shig /bka' gdams lha ba ni las de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no/

༈ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan yid 'ongs po ṭa la// mdzes byed 'jig rten khams gsum gyi// ston pa gnyis pa 'jig rten dbang*// de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /yan lag bdun pa dang skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang*/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su gyur pa ni// sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba g.yas gnyis pas shel gyi phreng ba/ g.yon gnyis pas utpal dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi ngos la 'od dpag med pa dang bcas pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ ba spu'i bu ga re re bzhin yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa dang bcas pa/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥde las 'od zer 'phros/ spyan ras gzigs ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ yid kyi phyag mchod bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la dmigs shing*/ sems can la snying rje chen po bsgom bzhin pas/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ /zhes ci 'grub bzla'o// thun 'jog khar/ ye shes sems dpa' mdun du bzhugs pa la/ ārghaṃ nas shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ dge ba bsngo/ oṃ muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya'o// 'di'i bsgom bzlas kyi lung 'bogs tshul ni/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gzugs bris 'bur gang rung gi mdun du maṇḍal me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod/ chu gnyis nyer (357) spyod bshams/ byin rlabs dang bdag bskyed sogs gong gsal thub pa'i skabs ltar la/ mdun bskyed/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdakar po las spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po

sogs nas bzlas pa'i bar/ mchod pa sngar ltar la/ mchod sngags/ oṃ lo ke shwo ra sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ sogs sbyar/ bstod pa/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs bya/ chos bshad skabs/ de la ji skad du/ thugs rje che zhes gang grags la// snying rje chen po de la bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying rje chen po gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'di nyid mkha' khyab kyi skye dgu ma lus pa'i mgon skyabs gcig pu pa yin mod/ lhag par bod yul mun pa'i rgyal khams 'di thugs brtse ba chen pos gdul bya'i zhing du bdag gir mdzad pas khab can pa'i lha skal spyan ras gzigs dang chos skal yi ge drug pa yin cing 'di la sngags gsar rnying kun nas sgrub thabs kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas 'byung ba las/ 'dir sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sogs/ grags pa'i nang tshan byams snying rje'i mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom bzlas dang snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting 'dzin nyams su len pa'i snod rung du byed pa sogs nas bsgom bzlas kyi lung tshang ba gang gi thub pa'i skabs ltar lha sngags kha sgos la btang*/ rjes kyi bya ba'ang der bshad pa ltar bya'o // spyan gzigs sems dpa' kun 'dus kyi// sgrub thabs ngo mtshar yid dga'i gnas// bka' gdams pa yi yi dam lhar// kun gyi snying po yin par grags// bka' gdams lha bzhi las 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no/ ༈ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jigs pa kun las skyob mdzad cing*// dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa// yid la bsam pa'i don kun stsol// sgrol ma de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ (358) bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang tshan du gyur pa// sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du tāṃ ljang khu// de'i 'od kyis lus gang*/

rnam smin rdos bcas ngang sdig sgrib lhan cig tu sbyangs/ rang nyid sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon utpal sngon po'i rtsa ba bzung ba snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i skyil krung phyid pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur// thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i tāṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ /phyag dang mchod pa yid la bya zhing ngag nas mi brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho gnyis su med par thim/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lha sku la sems rtse gcig tu gtad la mnyam par bzhag bzlas pa ni tāṃ gi mtha' skor du yi ge bcu pas bskor ba bsgoms la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ gzungs sngags kyis bskor ba gsal btab la/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma ārya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re sarba duṣṭaṃ/ pra duṣṭaṃ/ ma ma kṛ te/ dzaṃ bha ya/ stambha ya/ mo hā ya/ bhandha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣṭaṃ st+wambha ni tā re swā hā/ zhes pa'ang ci 'grub bzla/ thun 'jog yar/ ya ེ shes pa mdun du bzhugs pa la/ ārghaṃ nas shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ dge ba bsngo/ oṃ muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya'o// yang phyag 'tshal nyer gcig 'don na/ dam tshig pa gang ltar bskyed pa'i thugs ka'i (359)'od kyis/ ye shes lha mo mdun du spyan drangs phyag mchod 'bul/ skyabs sbyin gyi 'og tu bdag dang bsrung bya rnams tshud par byas la/ phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i skabs su yid kyis phyag 'tshal bar mos/

bstod pa gang nus 'don/ rjes gong dang 'dra'o// 'di'i bzlas lung byed thabs ni/ sgrol ma'i sku gzugs bris 'bur gang rung zhig gi mdun du/ maṇḍal me tog gi tshom bu bkod / mchod pa rgya chen bshams/ chos skyong dang cha gsum sogs 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'ang ci rigs su bsham mo/ / mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byas kyang rung*/ skad cig gi oṃ las byung ba'i mchod par mos pa tsam byas nas/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum brjod pa tsam gyis chog /bdag bskyed bzlas pa dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal bar sngar ltar bya/ mdun bskyed/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ ljang gu las 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu sogs nas bzlas pa'i bar/ mchod pa sngar ltar la/ mchod sngags/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri sogs sbyar/ bstod pa phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gam/ bsdu na/ zhing khams thams cad yongs su dag pa lta bu shloka gcig tsam gyis bstod/ chos bshad skabs/ de'ang don dam par rgyal ba thams cad kyi yum mchog rdo rje btsun mo nyid rnam pa byang chub sems ma chen mo'i tshul gyis rgyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las sgrub pa la dus gsum gshegs pa gang las kyang khyad par du 'phags pa rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma 'di nyid sngon gyi thugs bskyed kyi khyad par las 'gro ba rnams 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las skyobs par mdzad pa la thugs rje'i rtsal shugs shin tu myur ma dang dpa' mo zhes grags shing*/ mtshan tsam bzung bas kyang 'jigs pa kun las skyob cing*/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ snyigs ma'i dus mthar phyin zhing 'grub thag nye bar gsungs pa 'di la rgyud dang man ngag zhal gzigs sogs la brten (360)pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa mtha' dang mu med pa mchis pa las/ gangs can 'dir shin tu grags che zhing byin rlabs kyi bka' babs mchog dang ldan pa 'di ni/

sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sogs gong ltar la/ lha bzhi zhes grags pa'i nang tshan phyi'i bar chad sel ba rje btsun sgrol ma'i sgom bzlas dang rjes dran drug nyams su len pa'i snod rung du byed pa sogs brjod la maṇḍal 'bul/ yan lag bdun pa/ skyabs sems rnams bya/ 'thub na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas par 'bogs par gsungs pa ni sngar ma thob pa la dgongs pas skabs 'dir mi dgos/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa 'di ltar 'bul 'tshal/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/ /sogs lan gsum/ de nas lha bskyed sogs/ sgom bzlas kyi lung tshang ba sngar bshad thub pa ltar lha sngags 'byin 'jug byas pas 'thus shing*/ rjes kyi bya ba'ang de gas rigs 'gre'o// 'di dag ni bzlas lung la brten pa'i sgrub thabs zhes gsungs so// sngon dus kun nas ches dar yang*// deng song phal cher nub pa dang*// gzhan gyis rigs 'gres slad mthong nas// dga' bas snying por sbrel 'di'o// bka' gdams lha bzhi las/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// dar rgyas 'phel/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ mtha' dag 'gro ba sgrol ba'i slad// mi g.yo mgon la rab btud nas// gtum po'i sgrub thabs bla med pa// mdo tsam bdag gis bri bar bya/

/mi g.yo sngon po bka' gdams lugs bsgom par 'dod pas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ lus thams cad gsal zhing dag par byas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ārma ko3haṃ/ 'od zer des sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs// puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba bi shwa pū dza me gha sa mu dra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rdo rje bur ral bzang spyod nas byung ba ltar yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi rnams bsgom/ swa bhā wa dang shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyang (361)stong pa'i ngang las baṃ raṃ las pad nyi'i gdan la rang sems hūm̐ las rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā dzñā na kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma koḥhaṃ/ de las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gnyis steng 'og tu yon por gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon rdo rje zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdig mdzub thugs kar gtod pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas tshogs bdag glang sna dang dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad brdzis pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang*// dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan cing*/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sprul pa'i khro bo nam mkha' gang bar 'phro ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma la hūm̐ 'od 'bar pa/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ spro na gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyang 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yang lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/

snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar yi ge bcu pas bskor bar bsgoms la/ pho nya sgrob dang me sbar ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ /ces ci nus su bzla'o// mjug tu me dmigs bsdus la/ yig brgya bzla/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dkar gtor snod chu btsang gis bkang ba bshams la/ oṃ āḥbighnan ta kṛ ta hūm̐ gis bsal/ oṃ gyi sgra dang 'od kyis gtor ma snod dang bcas pa stong par sbyang*/ āḥrin po che'i snod (362)zab cing rgya che ba bdud rtsi dkar pos gang ba/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi bkug te thim pas/ gtor ma bdud rtsis rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma chos skyong sems can thams cad khro bo mi g.yo ba'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ snying po'i mthar/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis yi dam dang*/ a kā ro lan bdun gyis gzhan rnams la phul/ ārghaṃ nas shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ chos dbyings rang bzhin ind+ra nī la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brjid pa'i sku// ye shes ral gri rdo rje zhags pa bsnams// khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces brjod la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ dge ba bsngo/ oṃ muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ thun mtshams su yang lha yi snang ba dang ma bral bar bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang ni/ thun mong ba bka' gdams lha bzhi gzhan nams kyi bzlas lung 'bogs tshul de nyid la don pa spobs pas chog pa yin cing*/ khyad par can ni maṇḍal gru bzhi/ gru bcad sngon po la dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang bcas pa/ lte bar nyi gdan la tshom bu sngon pa ོ// me tog sngon po sil mar dgram// mchog gtor rgya che ba bsham// bdag bskyed tshang bar sngon du btang*// mchod pa byin brlabs ni/

oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs kyis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu dpag tu med par gyur/ oṃ ārghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ (363) nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ de nas mdun bskyed ni bdag bskyed ltar la/ rang sems dang*/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor la gzhan tshang ba bzlas pa'i bar btang*/ mchod pa sngar ltar la sngags/ oṃ ārya a tsa le sa pa ni sogs sbyar/ chos dbyings rang bzhin sogs kyis bstod// gtong 'bul gong smos ltar la mgron spyan 'dren mi dgos pas gshegs gsol kyang mi byed/ de nas gzhi bdag gtor ma dang bgegs gtor spyi 'gro zhig btang*/ slob mas chos bshad skabs/ 'dir skabs su babs pa/ khro bo'i dbang po gtum chen mi g.yo ba 'di ni ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs su dge slong bsam gtan pa zhig la bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gis bar chad rtsom pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas khro bo chen po 'di nyid spros te bdud 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad tshar bcad cing zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan pas/ bdud kyi bar du gcod pa la lhag par bsngags pa sangs rgyas kyis thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo yin par gsungs pa dang*/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud las/ ston pa/ 'tshang rgya kar bdud 'dul ba'i mdzad pa ston pa na/ bcom ldan 'das nyid gtum po mi g.yo ba'i sku bzhengs te bdud sde rnam par 'thag par byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bdud dpung thams cad tshar bcad/ bdud kyi bu mo rab bkram thams cad chags chen gyi spyod pas rjes su bzung ste/

bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing de'i tshe mi g.yo bla na med pa'i rgyud gsung bar bshad la/ de'i sgrub thabs rgyud dang slob dpon so so'i man ngag mang du byung ba'i bka' srol mang du mchis pa las/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sogs gong ltar la/ lha bzhi zhes grags pa'i nang gi bar chad sel ba khro bo mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs dang chos drug nyams su len pa'i snod rung du byed pa'i rjes gnang khyad par can bsgrub pa la (364) sogs pas mtshams sbyar nas maṇḍal 'bul ba lag sa/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs kyi skyabs sems lan gsum bya/ de nas dmigs pa 'di rnams rim bzhin sgoms mdzod/ /ces brda sbyar la mngon rtogs ltar stong par sbyang pa nas/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ /ces gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar du brjod/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i lha sku de'ang snang bzhin du stong*/ stong bzhin du snang*/ snang stong zung 'jug me long nang du shar ba'i gzugs brnyan lta bu la mnyam par zhog cig /ces brjod la dar cig bzhag /slar bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa la mos gus drag tu byas pas thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba baiḍūrya thag pa lta bu byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas bskor du 'khod par sgoms sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ snying po lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi bgrang phreng mgo thog tu bzhag la snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ de nas mi dmigs rnam gsum 'di ltar sgoms shig /thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng bcas pa las drag po'i me lce 'jigs dus bskal pa'i me lta bu/ tsha ba/ rtsub pa/ drag pa/ rno ba/ stobs ldan/ shugs can/ myur ba ste mtshan nyid bdun ldan 'bar/ thog mar hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa me nang du 'ur gyis 'bar/

de las kyang me lce 'khyog pos rang gi lus kyi nang dmar mer gyis gang bas sdig sgrib nad gdon bag chags dang bcas pa skad cig gis bsregs par sgoms shig /yi ge bcu pa bdun tsam bzla/ de nas me cher 'bar/ lus kyi sgo dgu nas kyang me lce sbrul gyi lce ltar dmar myug myug byung*/ mthar ba spu'i bu ga'i sgo thams cad nas kyang dmar lam lam mched/ phyi'i me ri'i gur khang dang 'dres pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad cham gyis bsregs par (365)sgoms shig /yi ge bcu pa bdun tsam bzla/ de las kyang me chen 'bar/ 'dom dang mda' rgyang dang rgyang grags dang dpag tshad kyi bar du lhab lhab 'bar zhing mched pas bstan dgra gdug pa can rnams dang*/ nad dang dal yams kyi bdag mo mthu mo rnams/ rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad cing byer bar sgoms shig /yig bcu gong ltar bzla/ 'di ltar snang ba'i phyi nang gi chos thams cad snang ba tsam nas bden par ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bur sgoms mdzod/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐/ zhes brjod la cung zad bzhag /sgyu ma lta bu'i snang ba de'ang mi dmigs pa stong nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings su mnyam par zhog mdzod/ phaṭa ces brjod la mnyam par bzhag /rjes gtong rag maṇḍal sogs sngar ltar bya// cho ga'i rjes kyi bya ba'ang spyi dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par mchod pa gsar pa rgya cher bshams nas byin gyis brlabs/ dpon slob lhan cig tu 'bul/ yan lag bdun pa lan gsum yang bya/ dkar gsum gyi tsa ru'i ston mo bya'o// khro rgyal kun 'dus rab dga'i tog /bdud sde'i snying la 'jigs skyed pa// zab mo'i sgrub thabs gsang por smras// dge des gtum po'i gnas thob shog /a ti sha'i zhal gyis gdams pa khro bo gtum po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// dar rgyas 'phel/ ces sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las khol du phyungs te kha gsal gyis brgyan pa'o// dge legs 'phel/// /
